scope: The exact 143 profile_unavailable entries from the earlier 497-profile audit.
earlierAuditCorrection: Every earlier unavailable URL had an erroneous trailing colon. Removing it and revisiting the original profile allowed all 143 to be read. A temporary 429 for the final 23 pages was retried slowly; all succeeded.
method: Read all 143 corrected Art of Pokémon profiles and extract listed X links.
Exclude company/studio credits and compare with the 42 existing Pokira illustrator IDs/names.
Review publicly accessible quoted original posts for the eleven individual accounts, including the artist-linked Pokémon account for Akira Komayama.
Verify the three qualifying original announcements, authors, and dates with official X oEmbed.
Use professional biographies and illustrator-owned websites for independent-status evidence.
limitations: Accessible timeline excerpts and search indexes do not guarantee exhaustive X history. Unverified individuals remain unverified rather than rejected.
No illustrator was added to Pokira and no production deployment was made for this research.
